---
title: "Methods and validation"
---




| Course concept | Where it is used |
|---|---|
| Regularization / partial pooling | empirical-Bayes shrinkage of every rate and percentage; ridge models |
| Clustering, model selection | K-Means baseline, Gaussian mixtures, BIC + bootstrap stability for k |
| Label evaluation | agreement with blind hand labels, Cohen's kappa, ARI |
| Concept drift | pooled vs per-era fits; rolling-window coefficients |
| Time-aware cross-validation | forward-chained seasons for net rating and title models |
| Gradient boosting + SHAP | net-rating model and feature importance |
| Calibration, uncertainty | bootstrap intervals; probability on the eventual champion |
| Text preprocessing, TF-IDF, embeddings (LSA), topic models, text clustering, zero-shot labels | play-by-play text layer (Text page) |
| Calibration, conformal intervals | salary-value intervals calibrated on held-out seasons |
| Ridge regression on sparse lineup data | player impact from lineups (Player impact page) |

## Small-sample adjustment beats per-36

Split-half test: fit on one half of a player's season, predict the other half. Deviance relative to raw rates
(negative = better).
